transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess work has just been getting hard. I do hair, and... I don't know, my hands just feel like they're moving through glue lately. Even just doing basic things, like sectioning hair or mixing the color, it... it takes me forever now. People have started noticing I'm just slower than I used to be. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed any shaking or tremor in your hands, especially when they're at rest?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. Just... just the slowness.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling unusually sad, down, or losing interest in things you normally enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess. Most days I just... I wake up with this heavy, flat feeling in my chest. It's just... I don't know. It just feels like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning anymore. So... yeah.
Have you ever had a period like this before—weeks of feeling this down or flat—at some point earlier in your life?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I've ever felt quite like... this before. Just recently.
Have you noticed feeling unusually cold, gaining weight, or becoming more constipated recently?
No... I don't think so. I haven't noticed any of that.
Have you noticed any stiffness or rigidity in your arms or legs, like your muscles feel tight or resistant when you move them?
No, I... my muscles feel fine. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have people told you that your face looks less expressive or more 'blank' than it used to, even when you're feeling emotions inside?

Um... I'm not sure about my face. No one's really said that. But... I guess I am just acting different lately. 

Like at the salon... I used to chat a lot with my clients, and I'd help the newer stylists. I even used to go hiking with friends. But now... I mostly just keep my head down. I just try to avoid people. I don't know... I just don't have that spark in me anymore.
Have you noticed any change in your sense of smell, like things not smelling as strong as they used to?
No... I don't think my sense of smell has changed. It seems normal to me.
Have you noticed any changes in your handwriting, like it becoming smaller or more cramped than it used to be?
No... I don't really write things down by hand that much anyway. But... it looks normal to me.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping much more than usual?
Um... no, not really. I sleep fine, I guess. I haven't really noticed any changes with that.
Thinking back, did the slowness in your hands and movements start before you began feeling down and flat, or did the low mood come first and the slowness followed after?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't... I haven't really noticed my hands being slow. So I don't know.
Have you noticed any changes in the way you walk, like taking smaller shuffling steps, feeling unsteady, or having trouble with your balance?
No... I don't think so. I walk the same as I always do.
